decks.notes: The deck focuses on powerful control elements, utilizing cards like Teferi, Jace, and Counterspell to dominate the game. It also includes versatile removal options such as Supreme Verdict and Prismatic Ending. The inclusion of Omnath provides a strong threat that can quickly turn the tides in your favor. The mana base is well-tuned to support the deck's various color requirements. With the help of Kaheera as a companion, this control deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies and maintain board control until it can secure a victory.

The central idea of this Aggro-Affinity deck is to quickly flood the board with low-cost artifacts and use cards like Cranial Plating and Urza's Saga to boost their power and attack quickly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of creatures backed up by powerful artifacts to deal damage efficiently and effectively. Key cards like Signal Pest and Thought Monitor help maintain card advantage and synergy within the deck, while cards like Springleaf Drum and Glimmervoid ensure consistent mana production for casting multiple spells in a turn.

The deck focuses on controlling the game with a variety of removal spells and counterspells while ramping up mana with cards like Arboreal Grazer and Dryad of the Ilysian Grove. It utilizes Bring to Light to search for powerful spells like Scapeshift to close out the game by fetching Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and a bunch of Mountains to deal massive amounts of damage to the opponent. The addition of Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion allows for even more control through blinking creatures and permanents for extra value.

The main focus of this deck is to deal as much damage as possible to the opponent as quickly as possible. It utilizes a combination of efficient burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Spike, alongside aggressive creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear. The inclusion of cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Searing Blaze also helps control the opponent's board while continuing to apply pressure. The deck aims to win the game by overwhelming the opponent with damage before they have a chance to stabilize.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively deal damage to the opponent as quickly as possible, using efficient creatures and burn spells. The deck focuses on fast-paced gameplay and punishing the opponent for playing non-creature spells, while also utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble for additional card advantage. By maintaining a low mana curve and maximizing damage output, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can stabilize.

The main idea of this Jeskai Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan by countering their spells, removing their threats, and generating card advantage. It focuses on using spells like Counterspell, Prismatic Ending, and Lightning Bolt to control the battlefield, while also utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Archmage's Charm to out-value the opponent. The deck also has a solid creature base with Murktide Regent, Snapcaster Mage, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer to apply pressure and close out the game. Overall, it aims to control the game and win through incremental advantage.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle, using Cascade triggers to cheat out powerful threats like Crashing Footfalls. By combining efficient removal spells with disruptive creatures like Shardless Agent and Brazen Borrower, the deck aims to maintain tempo while forcing the opponent to react to its threats. The mana base is designed to support this strategy, with a mix of fetch lands and multi-color lands to ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

The deck focuses on quickly casting spells with Cascade effects to put pressure on the opponent while maintaining control with counter spells and versatile cards like Brazen Borrower and Prismari Command. By utilizing cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a constant stream of threats. The mana base is fine-tuned to support the aggressive gameplay, allowing for consistent casting of spells and ensuring a smooth cascade chain. The inclusion of powerful cards like Jace, the Mind Sculptor adds additional versatility and control options to the deck.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying aggressive creatures like Stormwing Entity, Ragavan, and Scourge of the Skyclaves to put pressure on the opponent. With cards like Death's Shadow and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to lower its own life total to maximize their power. Spells like Lightning Bolt and Temur Battle Rage provide additional reach and ways to finish off the opponent. Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek help disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck operates on a fine line between maximizing its own power and managing its life total to secure victory.

The deck focuses on filling the graveyard with cards like Stinkweed Imp and Golgari Thug, triggering powerful graveyard recursion effects like Prized Amalgam and Narcomoeba. By consistently dredging and discarding cards with cards like Cathartic Reunion and Thrilling Discovery, the deck can quickly put together explosive combos and overwhelm opponents with cards like Creeping Chill and Conflagrate. The deck is able to maintain a strong presence on the battlefield through continuous dredge effects and graveyard synergies, making it a formidable threat in the Modern format.

The deck focuses on using powerful Eldrazi creatures and disruptive spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Reality Smasher, the deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. Chalice of the Void and Karn, the Great Creator provide additional disruption, while cards like Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and All Is Dust serve as board wipes to deal with opposing threats. The deck also includes utility lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Scavenger Grounds to support its game plan.

The main concept of this deck is to swarm the board with a diverse group of human creatures that synergize well together. The deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Champion of the Parish and Mantis Rider, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Meddling Mage and Kitesail Freebooter. The inclusion of Aether Vial allows for quick deployment of creatures while the land base of the deck ensures consistent mana production. Overall, the goal of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and efficient creature-based strategy.

This Jund Aggro deck focuses on utilizing disruptive spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Raven's Crime to control the opponent's hand while applying pressure with aggressive creatures like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Seasoned Pyromancer. The deck also leverages cards like Wrenn and Six and Life from the Loam to maintain card advantage and mana consistency. With the ability to efficiently remove threats with cards like Assassin's Trophy and Unholy Heat, this deck aims to outvalue and overwhelm opponents in the early to mid-game stages of a match.

This deck aims to quickly overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures like Tarmogoyf, Ragavan, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, supported by powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Abrupt Decay. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for recurring threats and spells, while cards like Mishra's Bauble and Urza's Saga provide card advantage and additional resources. By utilizing a mix of early pressure and disruptive spells, the deck can consistently apply pressure and disrupt opponents' strategies in order to secure a swift victory.

This Jund Aggro deck utilizes low-cost creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. With Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion, the deck focuses on recurring threats and generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Wrenn and Six. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek to disrupt the opponent's game plan. By combining efficient threats with powerful disruption, this deck aims to put pressure on opponents and close out games quickly.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and removal spells to apply constant pressure on the opponent, while also disrupting their hand with discard spells. It also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Wrenn and Six to control the game and generate value. The mana base is designed to support the color requirements of the deck's spells and includes powerful lands like Blackcleave Cliffs and Raging Ravine. Overall, the deck aims to quickly outpace and overwhelm the opponent through a combination of efficient threats and disruption.

The main goal of this Abzan Aggro deck is to establish early board presence and disrupt the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes powerful threats like Tarmogoyf and Stoneforge Mystic to apply pressure and close out the game quickly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Lingering Souls and Kaya, Orzhov Usurper provides additional value and versatility. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive while also maintaining some control elements to outpace the opponent.

The deck focuses on quickly cycling through creatures with a high mana cost to empty the battlefield, then casting Living End to bring them all back into play at once. This strategy allows the player to quickly overwhelm their opponent with powerful creatures while disrupting their game plan. The deck also includes disruptive elements like counter spells and creature removal to control the board and protect the combo. The key idea is to use the cycling ability of certain creatures to set up a game-winning Living End play.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying a board of Merfolk creatures and using their tribal synergies to overwhelm the opponent with aggression. The key strategy is to use cards like Aether Vial to cheat in creatures, while utilizing cards like Master of the Pearl Trident and Lord of Atlantis to pump up your team. Cards like Tide Shaper can also disrupt your opponent's mana base, while cards like Brazen Borrower provide additional tempo plays. The deck aims to finish off the opponent quickly with a mix of combat damage and burn spells.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize combo cards like Through the Breach, Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast, and Emrakul, the Aeons Torn to quickly put powerful creatures onto the battlefield. Utilizing cards like Chandra, Flamecaller and Chandra, Awakened Inferno for additional damage and board control. Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Planebound Accomplice are used to disrupt opponent's mana bases. Lightning Bolt and Bonecrusher Giant offer removal options while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides card advantage. The deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its combo potential and disruptive elements.

This deck utilizes Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a powerful control finisher, with a wide range of multicolored spells to trigger his ability and generate card advantage. The deck also includes strong removal and disruption spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies. The mana base is carefully crafted to support the multiple colors needed for Niv-Mizzet's ability, ensuring consistency in casting spells and maximizing his potential. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent through card advantage and efficient removal, while also offering flexibility and versatility in its gameplay.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Underworld Cookbook along with other low-cost creatures and spells to quickly pressure the opponent and deal damage. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Bonecrusher Giant provide early threats, while Ovalchase Daredevil and Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar offer recurring value. The deck also includes efficient removal options like Lightning Bolt and versatile cards like Finale of Devastation. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key artifacts, while Wrenn and Six provide additional value. The mana base includes fetch lands and dual lands for consistency and flexibility.

The main concept of this UR Aggro Modern deck is to use efficient and aggressive creatures like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, and Dragon's Rage Channeler, paired with disruptive spells like Counterspell and Force of Negation to control the game and out-tempo the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Thought Scour help fuel delve for Murktide Regent while also providing card selection. Lightning Bolt provides additional reach and removal, while Expressive Iteration helps dig deeper into the deck for more threats. Steam Vents and fetch lands provide consistent mana fixing for the deck's spells.

The key strategy of this UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy threats like Murktide Regent, Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, and Dragon's Rage Channeler to put pressure on the opponent. The deck uses efficient spells like Unholy Heat, Lightning Bolt, and Counterspell to control the board and protect its creatures. Mishra's Bauble and Thought Scour help fill the graveyard for delve and prowess triggers, while Expressive Iteration provides card advantage and selection. The deck aims to win through aggressive creature attacks and burn spells while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly play aggressive creatures like Delver of Secrets, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Murktide Regent and support them with spells like Lightning Bolt and Counterspell to control the board. Utilizing cantrips like Serum Visions, Thought Scour, and Expressive Iteration to dig into the deck for more threats and answers. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early, disrupt their game plan with counterspells and removal, and close out the game efficiently. It prioritizes tempo and aggression to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of efficient and evasive creatures like Sprite Dragon, Soul-Scar Mage, and Stormwing Entity, along with quick spells like Vapor Snag, Lightning Bolt, and Lava Dart to deal damage to the opponent swiftly. The deck also includes cards like Mishra's Bauble and Manamorphose to generate card advantage and maintain tempo. By applying pressure early on and keeping the opponent on the back foot, the deck aims to win the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize or mount a defense.

The main focus of this Modern UR Aggro deck is to quickly deploy cheap and aggressive creatures like Stormwing Entity, Sprite Dragon, and Monastery Swiftspear, while using spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Dart, and Gut Shot to control the board and deal direct damage to the opponent. Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help to dig for key cards and maintain tempo, while Dragon's Rage Channeler provides additional card advantage. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early and often, overwhelming them with a flurry of spells and creatures to secure victory.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) lands to generate a large amount of mana quickly. This mana is used to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Kozilek, Butcher of Truth and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger. The deck also includes control elements like Oblivion Stone and Karn Liberated to manage the board and disrupt opponents' strategies. The ability to quickly ramp up mana and play powerful threats while controlling the game state is the key strategy of this deck.

The deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Power Plant, Tower, and Mine) to generate large amounts of mana, allowing for powerful late-game plays. It includes various color-fixing artifacts and land tutors to ensure consistency, along with powerful control elements such as Oblivion Stone and Karn Liberated. With the addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck aims to ramp quickly into big threats like Wurmcoil Engine and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger, while also utilizing Golos, Tireless Pilgrim for additional value. Overall, the deck aims to control the game and overwhelm opponents with its powerful threats.

The deck focuses on assembling the Urzatron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Power Plant, Urza's Tower) to generate a large amount of mana quickly. It utilizes powerful control elements such as Karn Liberated, Karn, the Great Creator, and Ugin, the Spirit Dragon to dominate the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The primary strategy of this deck is to utilize counterspells, removal, and card advantage to control the game and outvalue the opponent. By playing threats like Solitude and Shark Typhoon, while also using cards like Chalice of the Void and Supreme Verdict to disrupt the opponent's game plan, this deck aims to grind out wins through attrition. The inclusion of powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Jace, the Mind Sculptor provide additional card advantage and tempo advantage, allowing the pilot to dictate the pace of the game.

This UW Control deck focuses on utilizing powerful control spells and card advantage to manipulate the game in your favor. Cards like Teferi, Hero of Dominaria and Jace, the Mind Sculptor provide strong control elements, while cards like Chalice of the Void and Counterspell help disrupt opponent's strategies. Spreading Seas and Prismatic Ending can handle opponent's threats, while Supreme Verdict helps keep the board clear. The deck aims to control the pace of the game through counterspells, removal, and card advantage, ultimately securing victory through a controlled and calculated approach.

This deck focuses on controlling the game by countering spells, removing threats, and drawing cards. It utilizes powerful planeswalkers and versatile creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl to maintain board presence. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure consistent access to all colors of mana. With a mix of removal, counterspells, and card advantage, it aims to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a long game, ultimately gaining control of the battlefield and securing victory through attrition.

This deck focuses on controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's strategies while utilizing powerful creatures and efficient removal spells. Stoneforge Mystic and equipment cards like Batterskull provide additional threats and versatility. The inclusion of Teferi, Time Raveler helps stall the opponent's game plan and provides additional disruption.
